name: ai_studio_agent_fanout
description: One AI Studio brief request fanned out across the supervisor + five agents (sales_analyst, evidence, code_interpreter, product_copy, presenter), each LLM/tool span in order. Mirrors the Langfuse trace view in OCI APM.
queryText: show traces SpanName, gen_ai.agent.name as Agent, studio.data_source as DataSource, DurationMs where ServiceName = 'octo-genai-studio' and (SpanName like 'agent.invoke.%' or SpanName like 'coordinator.%' or SpanName like 'llm.invoke.%' or SpanName like 'tool.%' or SpanName = 'studio.brief') order by TimeStarted asc
